items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: Is he any relation to Earl Foster? No, no, no relative at all.

ctx.x: You never did know his real name? Foster, I do.
Foster, that's his name. Is he any relation to Earl Foster? No, no, no relative at all. Just Papad Foster? No, it's not a. Not Chy B.
